blocks.text: The theatre represents the gates of Erebus, from which smoke and flames come out.
Crowd of Demons and Furies, ORPHEUS.
ORPHEUS plays on the lyre. The Spectres and the Furies, astonished, try to drown his strains with their dances and to frighten him.

lines: That dares in these dark places,
If he is not a god.

blocks.text: approaching the spectres, playing on his lyre

lines: And may you be brought to pity
Ah! the fire that burns within my heart
Is a hundred times more fierce,
If you could see my heart,
If you could know my grief,
You would at last feel pity.

blocks.text: The spectres seem softened at the sweet strains of ORPHEUS.
During this chorus the gates of hell are thrown wide open; ORPHEUS, enchanting the spirits with his sweet sounds, opens his way between them and enters the abyss.
